features.title: Browse cities & countries
features.description: Material data tables list every city and country, with links from each city to its country record.

features.title: Server-side paging & sorting
features.description: Only the requested page is queried and returned, so the table stays responsive with tens of thousands of rows.

features.title: Search as you type
features.description: A debounced filter box queries the API by name prefix without firing a request on every keystroke.

features.title: Create & edit records
features.description: Reactive forms add or update cities and countries, with inline validation for required fields and coordinate formats.

features.title: Duplicate detection
features.description: Async validators check with the API before saving, blocking a duplicate city or an already-used country name or ISO code.

features.title: Bulk data import
features.description: A development-only seed endpoint loads countries and cities from an Excel source file into SQL Server.

hero.title: World Cities
hero.subtitle: ASP.NET Core Web API & Angular
hero.description: A full-stack web application for browsing, searching, and managing a database of world cities and countries. A C# ASP.NET Core Web API backed by SQL Server serves paged, sorted, and filtered data to an Angular Material front end.

layers.title: Data layer
items: Modelled City and Country entities with a one-to-many relationship, keys, and indexes on the columns used for lookups and sorting.
Configured the DbContext and generated the schema with EF Core code-first migrations against SQL Server.
Wrote a seed controller that reads the source spreadsheet with EPPlus and imports countries before cities, skipping records that already exist.

layers.title: API
items: Built RESTful CRUD controllers for cities and countries using async EF Core queries.
Created a generic ApiResult<T> that applies filtering, sorting, and paging to any IQueryable and returns the page with its paging metadata.
Validated sort and filter column names against the model's properties before building dynamic queries, to guard against injection.
Returned DTOs for list views so the client gets only the fields it needs, including the related country name.
Added structured request logging with Serilog (console and SQL Server) and Swagger docs for the API in development.

layers.title: Front end
items: Built list and edit views for cities and countries with Angular Material tables, paginators, sort headers, and form fields.
Defined a generic abstract data service and a shared base form component to cut repeated HTTP and validation code across features.
Used RxJS to debounce filter input and to clean up subscriptions when components are destroyed.
Implemented custom async validators that call the API to check for duplicates before a form can be submitted.

overview: World Cities is split into two projects in one Visual Studio solution: WorldCitiesAPI, an ASP.NET Core 6 Web API that owns the data and business rules, and WorldCities, an Angular 13 single-page application that consumes it. The database is seeded from a spreadsheet of real-world city data, then exposed through REST endpoints that support server-side paging, sorting, and filtering so the UI stays fast even with large tables.
